title: 第39章 四人一狗上山

第39章 四人一狗上山-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“二壮，你怎么来了？”李青山望着和他哥一脸憨厚笑哈哈的二壮，开口问道。

“山哥，我也想上山，我也想跟着你去打野物，带着我一个呗！”

二壮脸上满是兴奋之色，等待着李青山的回答。

“不行，赶紧回家，别出来胡闹，你爹不让你进老林子，要是让你爹知道了，还不得被气死？”李青山道。

“山哥，凭啥我哥都能去，我就不行，我也有一把好力气，我跟着你上山肯定不会添乱，而且我也不要什么钱，你管我吃的就行了，我哥都上山了，你就带着我一个呗？”

“山哥，求你了！”

二壮一脸乞求的望着李青山，开口道。

“唉！”

“算了，带你一个吧！”

李青山想了想后，最终还是决定带着二壮，原本的三个人就变成了四个人，要是遇到什么危险，也好照顾一些。

“大哥，你看吧，我就说山哥肯定会带我一个的，山哥，太谢谢你了，我一定在老林子里面好好表现，不给你添乱。”

二壮心中大喜，连忙给李青山表态道。

李青山拍了拍二壮的肩膀，这要是让李财叔知道了，不知道在家里会不会被气炸了。

四个人，一条狗，一把猎枪，一把猎弓，三把柴刀，一把红缨枪，还有大量的绳子，一口铁锅，水壶等物！

这就是李青山这次上山的全部装备了。

此次上山。

李青山的目标是改善家庭条件，爹妈，嫂子，自己，王乃香，柔雪身上的衣服全部换一遍，全部换成新的，这可是要不少钱的。

以前家里穷，没什么衣服穿。

就连嫂子柳桂香的鞋子，都要捡大伯母剩下的，身上的衣裳就更别说了，全部都是穿别人剩下的，别人穿的藏破烂的衣裳，再给李青山和李青山的爹娘穿，这些年一直都是这么过来的，可以说李青山从小到大，就没有穿过一件新衣裳，包括嫁过来的嫂子也是如此。

直到现在。

李青山和嫂子，爹娘身上穿着的，还都是老李家那群牲口剩下来的衣裳，想到这里就感觉到憋屈，恨不得现在回去狠狠抽李老屯那老畜牲一巴掌，真不是个东西，还好自己重生了，终于可以好好整治整治李老屯一家子。

"Er Zhuang, why are you here?" Li Qingshan asked, looking at Er Zhuang who was laughing innocently with his brother.

"Brother Shan, I also want to go up the mountain. I also want to follow you to hunt wild animals. Just take me with you!"

Er Zhuang's face was full of excitement, waiting for Li Qingshan's answer.

"No, go home quickly and don't come out to cause trouble. Your father won't let you enter the old forest. If your father finds out, will he be angry to death?" Li Qingshan said.

"Brother Shan, why can my brother go, but I can't? I also have a lot of strength. I will definitely not cause trouble if I follow you up the mountain. And I don't need any money. You can just care about my food. My brother has already gone up the mountain, so you can just take me with you?"

"Brother Shan, please!"

Er Zhuang looked at Li Qingshan with a begging look on his face and said.

"Alas!"

"Forget it, I'll take you one!"

After Li Qingshan thought about it, he finally decided to take Erzhuang with him. The original three people became four people. If there was any danger, it would be easier to take care of them.

"Brother, look, I said Brother Shan will definitely take me with him. Brother Shan, thank you so much. I will definitely behave well in the old forest and not cause any trouble for you."

Er Zhuang was overjoyed and quickly expressed his stance to Li Qingshan.

Li Qingshan patted Er Zhuang on the shoulder. If Uncle Li Cai found out about this, I wonder if he would be furious at home.

Four people, a dog, a shotgun, a hunting bow, three hatchets, a red tassel gun, a lot of ropes, an iron pot, a kettle and other items!

This is all the equipment Li Qingshan has for going up the mountain this time.

This time up the mountain.

Li Qingshan's goal is to improve the conditions of his family. It costs a lot of money to change all the clothes on his parents, sister-in-law, himself, Wang Naixiang, and Rouxue.

My family used to be poor and had nothing to wear.

Even the shoes of his sister-in-law Liu Guixiang have to be picked up by her aunt, not to mention the clothes on her body. They are all leftover by others. The tattered clothes worn by others are then worn by Li Qingshan and Li Qingshan's parents. This has been the case for these years. It can be said that Li Qingshan has never worn a new piece of clothing since he was a child, including his married sister-in-law.

Until now.

Li Qingshan, his sister-in-law, and his parents were still wearing the leftover clothes from the old beasts of Lao Li's family. Thinking of this, they felt aggrieved. They wished they could go back and slap that old beast of Li Laotun now. He was really nothing. Fortunately, he was reborn and could finally take care of Li Laotun's family.
